description: `first :nums = 1` assigns to a reporter call, not a place, raising the runtime's own `ol-not-a-place` (issue #94, `stage: "semantic"` — this is the same defect the semantic checker's `checker-not-a-place.ts` rule from issue #113 also catches at `stage: "semantic"`, but `execute()` runs `check()` before Phase 2). The structural check happens before any operand is evaluated, so `:nums` need not even be bound. `params.text` carries the FULL target surface text (`first :nums`), reconciled with the semantic-stage rule (issue #156, `spec/tooling.md:216-222`'s worked example) rather than just the offending callee's name. Issue #815: `execute()` now runs Layer 1 and Layer 2 before Phase 2 and refuses a program carrying an `error`-severity finding (`spec/execution-model.md:659-664`), so no event is emitted and the diagnostic delivered here is the CHECK's. The runtime's own copy of the rule still exists and still runs — under the `runUnchecked` opt-out — and is collapsed into the check's by the de-duplication rule (`spec/execution-model.md:741-748`), which is why the runtime's copy does not appear beside the check's. The other findings recorded here are independent faults in the same program, each reported once.
